General-content county map showing towns (townships), numbered town sections, some rural land tracts with owner's names, rural buildings, and householder's names. Relief shown by hachures. Hand colored to emphasize town boundaries and areas. "Entered according to Act of Congress in the year 1856 by Robert Pearsall Smith in the ... Eastern District of Pennsylvania." LC copy imperfect: Brittle, missing small edge sections, sectioned to 6 panels to enable folding. Includes 24 village insets (including Olean), local business directories, and illustrations of prominent buildings/residences.
